 Motorola Edge 70 Neo roundup: India launch date, specifications, and design
 By Marcia Sekhose - Published On: 21 November 2026 | 09:00 IST Motorola is launching a new smartphone next week. The Edge 70 Neo will join the ever-growing Motorola Edge 70 series, which already has four phones: the Edge 70, Edge 70 Pro, Edge 70 Max, and Edge 70 Pro+, and the Edge 70 Fusion. Among these, the Motorola Edge 70 Neo is expected to be the most affordable model, based on its predecessors. 
 Since the launch is only a few days away, here’s all you need to know about the Motorola Edge 70 Neo . 
 Table of Contents
 Motorola Edge 70 Neo India launch date 
 Motorola Edge 70 Neo design and colours 
 Motorola Edge 70 Neo specifications 
 Motorola Edge 70 Neo India launch date 
 The Motorola Edge 70 Neo is scheduled to launch in India on November 24th. The smartphone is confirmed to go on sale via Flipkart and Motorola India’s online store. We should know more about the phone’s sale offers and availability on launch day. 
 Motorola Edge 70 Neo design and colours 
 The Motorola Edge 70 Neo looks quite like the other Edge series phones, with the square-shaped camera module and curved edges. The phone measures 8.49mm thick and weighs 204g. It comes in four Pantone colours and finishes: Acetate Finish PANTONE Gray Lilac (Light Pink), Leather-Inspired Finish PANTONE Milky Blue (Light Blue), Silk-Inspired Finish PANTONE Mountain View (Deep Green), and Leather-Inspired Finish PANTONE Sage (Light Green). 
 Source: Motorola Motorola Edge 70 Neo specifications 
 Motorola has revealed the phone’s complete specifications and features. It has a 6.8-inch Super HD (2772 x 1272) Extreme AMOLED display with a 144Hz refresh rate, 5200 nits of peak brightness, and Gorilla Glass 7i protection. It’s an upgrade over its predecessor, the Edge 60 Neo, with a higher refresh rate and peak brightness. It’s powered by the Snapdragon 7s Gen 3 chipset paired with 8GB LPDDR5X RAM, expandable up to 24GB with RAM Boost, and 128GB UFS3.1 storage that’s expandable up to 1TB with a microSD card. 
 For optics, you get a 50MP Sony LYTIA 710 primary sensor, a 2MP Macro Vision sensor, and a dedicated 3-in-1 light sensor at the back. There’s a 32MP front camera for selfies on the Edge 70 Neo. The camera setup seems like a downgrade since there’s no ultra-wide or telephoto, which the Edge 60 Neo offers. 
 Source: Motorola The phone packs a 7000mAh battery with 45W TurboPower and 7.5W wired reverse charging support. Battery capacity has definitely seen a bump from the 5,000mAh on the Edge 60 Neo. Motorola promises up to 53 hours of battery life on the Edge 70 Neo. This is something we can confirm by reviewing the phone, but the 7,000mAh battery should easily last an entire day. The phone also supports bypass charging, making it a good choice for gamers. 
 On the software front, the Edge 70 Neo will launch with Android 16 out of the box. It will get 3 OS updates and 5 years of security updates. The phone also comes with IP64 water resistance and MIL-STD-810H certification for durability. It comes with dual stereo speakers powered by Dolby Atmos.  
 Since the Neo model usually sits in the affordable segment in the Edge series, we expect the same treatment for the upcoming Edge 70 Neo. The last Neo model that launched in India was the Edge 50 Neo in 2024 at a starting price of Rs 23,999. Things have changed since then, especially in the industry, with price hikes due to rising memory costs. So, the Motorola Edge 70 Neo will likely cost much more than expected.
